name: Emby增强[墨鱼整理版]
description: Emby官方客户端内调用外部播放器，该功能需要自行添加Emby服域名的MITM · 来源 墨鱼手记
text:
#!name=Emby增强[墨鱼整理版]
#!desc=Emby官方客户端内调用外部播放器，该功能需要自行添加Emby服域名的MITM · 来源 墨鱼手记
#!author=@renzhipengBot 原创，@AppleArcade 魔改

[MITM]
hostname = mb3admin.com, *.emby.wtf, *.plusmedia.site

[Script]
http-response ^https?:\/\/mb3admin.com\/admin\/service\/registration\/validateDevice, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rartv/EmbyPublic/test/quantumult-x/unlock.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response \/[Uu]sers\/\w{32}\/[Ii]tems\/\d+\??, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rartv/EmbyPublic/refs/heads/test/surge/emby-plugin.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response \/plugin\/scheme, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rartv/EmbyPublic/refs/heads/test/surge/emby-plugin.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-request (\/[Vv]ideos\/\d+\/stream\/.+\?.+&filename)|(\/[Vv]ideos\/\d+\/\w{32}\/[Ss]ubtitles\/\d+\/.+\?.+&filename), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rartv/EmbyPublic/refs/heads/test/surge/emby-plugin.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response (\/[Vv]ideos\/\d+\/stream\?.+&filename)|(\/[Vv]ideos\/\d+\/\w{32}\/[Ss]ubtitles\/.+&filename), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rartv/EmbyPublic/refs/heads/test/surge/download_file_rename.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
